events.summary: Stage 1 only: APISIX etcd L3/L4 NetworkPolicy isolation and OpenBao auto-unseal/openbao-init hygiene. Stage 2 (apisix-etcd TLS + client-cert auth in apisix-infra.yaml/apisix.yaml) and portal/ static text updates are intentionally out of scope. No live cluster mutations performed in this lane; live cluster was inspected read-only (metadata only for Secrets).

Read-only inspection of the live cluster and repository verified: (1) platform-system had only apisix-admin-ingress-policy (app.kubernetes.io/name=apisix) and zero NetworkPolicies selecting app=apisix-etcd, while apisix-etcd serves plain HTTP :2379 with dataplane-mode=none and Service/apisix-etcd is bound to platform-system/waypoint; cluster-wide scan confirmed only ConfigMap/platform-system/apisix references apisix-etcd:2379 (apisix-ingress-controller calls apisix-admin:9180; readinessProbe is exec loopback; replicas=1; no ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor/dashboard/backup job). (2) CronJob/storage/openbao-auto-unseal omitted serviceAccountName and automountServiceAccountToken and set BAO_SKIP_VERIFY=true while dialing https://openbao-0.openbao-internal.storage.svc.cluster.local:8200. (3) Live Certificate/storage/openbao-tls dnsNames lacked openbao-0.openbao-internal.storage.svc.cluster.local (had only openbao-0.openbao-internal). (4) Secret/storage/openbao-init metadata showed empty labels (no velero.io/exclude-from-backup=true) and a kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration annotation from 08-4-storage.sh using kubectl apply.
evidence: runtime:read-only kubectl get deploy,svc,netpol -n platform-system -> only apisix-admin-ingress-policy present; apisix-etcd has app=apisix-etcd, istio.io/dataplane-mode=none, replicas=1, exec readinessProbe

runtime:read-only kubectl get cm,deploy,sts,ds,cj,job,servicemonitor,podmonitor,prometheusrule -A -> only ConfigMap/platform-system/apisix and Deployment/platform-system/apisix-etcd reference apisix-etcd/2379/2380; apisix-ingress-controller-configmap targets http://apisix-admin.platform-system.svc.cluster.local:9180/apisix/admin
runtime:read-only kubectl get certificate openbao-tls -n storage -> spec.dnsNames lacks openbao-0.openbao-internal.storage.svc.cluster.local
runtime:read-only kubectl get cronjob openbao-auto-unseal -n storage -> no serviceAccountName/automountServiceAccountToken, BAO_SKIP_VERIFY=true
runtime:read-only kubectl get secret openbao-init -n storage metadata -> managedFields kubectl-client-side-apply with last-applied-configuration annotation and no velero.io/exclude-from-backup label

events.summary: Added gitops/resources/apisix-etcd-ingress-policy.yaml (Ingress-only NetworkPolicy for app=apisix-etcd allowing only platform-system app.kubernetes.io/name=apisix on TCP 2379 + ambient HBONE 15008 per R200; omitting apisix-ingress-controller, waypoint, and peer port 2380), ArgoCD Application gitops/charts/narwhal-apps/templates/apisix-etcd-ingress-policy.yaml (wave 2, ServerSideApply, prune+selfHeal), upgrade-waves.json registration, and fail-loudly bootstrap apply in scripts/cluster/08-1-networking.sh. Hardened gitops/resources/openbao-unseal.yaml with dedicated ServiceAccount storage/openbao-auto-unseal (automountServiceAccountToken: false on SA and PodSpec), removed BAO_SKIP_VERIFY, mounted only ca.crt from Secret openbao-tls at /openbao/ca/ca.crt with BAO_CACERT=/openbao/ca/ca.crt. Updated scripts/cluster/08-4-storage.sh to add openbao-0.openbao-internal.storage.svc.cluster.local and .storage.svc to Certificate/openbao-tls dnsNames, create/replace openbao-init via 077-umask files without kubectl apply or --from-literal, and idempotently label velero.io/exclude-from-backup=true while removing kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration. Added R396 static check with 19 mutations and updated docs and lessons-log.
